n: This short psalm echoes the priestly blessing of Aaron: be gracious to us, bless us, make your face shine on us.

f.w: cause his face to shine upon us

n: Here is the purpose of Israel’s blessing: so that God’s way and saving power become known among all nations. God blesses his people to bless the world.
A refrain: let all peoples praise God.
Let the nations sing for joy, because God judges fairly and guides the nations.
The refrain repeats, framing the psalm’s center.
The earth has produced its harvest — a sign of God’s blessing.

f.w: Then shall the earth yield her increase

n: God will keep blessing us, and the whole world will come to reverence him.

f.w: all the ends of the earth shall fear him
